key.name: window-maximised
key.summary: Whether the main window is maximised

key.name: servers
key.summary: Configured servers as a JSON array. Never contains passwords.

key.name: servers-backup
key.summary: Holds the last unparseable value of "servers", so a corrupt or wrong-shaped value is not lost when the application next saves.

key.name: sample-interval-ms
key.summary: Minimum gap between samples in milliseconds

key.name: slow-sample-interval-ms
key.summary: Minimum gap between slow-tier samples in milliseconds
key.description: Controls how often the Queries and Tables and Indexes pages are refreshed. These statistics are far more expensive to collect than the Overview and Sessions data, so they are sampled less often.

key.name: statements-limit
key.summary: Rows fetched from pg_stat_statements per slow sample

key.name: relations-limit
key.summary: Rows fetched from each relation statistics view per slow sample

key.name: graph-points
key.summary: Number of points retained per graph series

key.name: hide-idle-sessions
key.summary: Hide idle sessions in the Sessions table
